data.name: Samiran
data.gender_notes: Samiran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One Who Has Mastery Over His Mind
data.long_meaning: One Who Has Mastery Over His Mind, Thoughts, and Actions; A Ruler or Controller. The name Samiran carries the meaning “One Who Has Mastery Over His Mind” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Samiran usually hope their child will grow to embody one who has mastery over his mind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the individual's ability to control his thoughts, emotions and actions, and lead a peaceful and contented life. It is a name for those who want to gain mastery over their mind and emotions.
data.etymology: Samiran belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One Who Has Mastery Over His Mind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samiran total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Samiran carries a sense of strength, dignity, and wisdom in Hindu culture. The name conveys a sense of someone who is in control of his emotions, thoughts, and actions. It also suggests someone who is a leader or ruler, as the name means 'one who has mastery.'
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, Samiran represents the ideal of self-mastery and self-discipline. It is a name that reminds us of the importance of controlling our thoughts, words, and actions, and of striving for inner peace and spiritual growth. The name also resonates with the Hindu belief in the power of the mind to shape one's reality and to attain enlightenment. Ultimately, Samiran is a name that inspires us to be mindful, present, and in control of our own destiny.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Samiran: Deeply contemplative, always absorbing knowledge with an unwavering mind. The name Samiran signifies one who is calm, introspective, and dedicated to the pursuit of wisdom and enlightenment.

The general trend indicates that people are embracing their cultural roots while also integrating them into their modern, digital identities.
